plugins.name: tstack
plugins.description: Six-stage chain that turns a rough product idea into a documented, milestone-sequenced, built project, two iteration skills for evolving it (tstack-specify-feature to add a feature, tstack-refactor to restructure how it's built), an adoption on-ramp (tstack-ingest) for projects that already have docs, a conditional UI design stage (tstack-design) for products with a UI, two off-chain companions for project status and end-of-session doc sweep, plus a manual-only autonomous runner (tstack-autopilot) that takes one milestone to an open PR and never merges.
